tagline: Leading diversified gaming and hospitality operator across North America
hero_kpi_rationale: Net revenues reflect the overall performance of the diversified portfolio of gaming and hospitality properties. Year-over-year growth of 2.1% is primarily driven by Digital segment performance (iGaming and sports betting) with significant increases in gaming volume and improved retention, as well as contributions from new properties such as Caesars Virginia and the renovation of Caesars New Orleans, partially offset by a decline in Las Vegas visitation.

risks.title: Tax Uncertainties
risks.score_rationale: The company has tax uncertainties, particularly regarding deductible tax deficits and tax credits, which could have a significant impact on financial results. The company recorded a tax benefit of $11 million in 2025.

risks.title: Goodwill Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded $182 million in goodwill impairments in 2025 within the regional segment, primarily due to declines in estimated future cash flows attributable to increased localized competition and challenges at certain properties.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces credit risks, particularly regarding gaming receivables, which could impact financial results. Credit loss provisions have been established to mitigate this risk.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has interest rate risks related to its variable rate debt. Since September 2024, rate decreases of 175 basis points have reduced interest expense by $62 million (2.6%). However, future rate increases could increase borrowing costs.

risks.title: Litigation and Claims
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation and claims, particularly regarding regulatory matters, which could impact financial results. Litigation provisions have been established to mitigate this risk.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces liquidity risks regarding its ability to repay debt. Ongoing debt reduction and the strategic transition to variable rate debt help mitigate this risk. Repayment decisions in the 2025 10-K demonstrate continued efforts.

risks.title: Online Gaming Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to significant regulatory risks in the gaming sector. Effective July 1, 2025, increases in tax rates on sports betting and iGaming became effective in certain jurisdictions, increasing platform expenses and gaming taxes in the Digital segment.

ai_positioning.summary: CZR does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its report. References to 'machine' relate to property elements or gaming (slot machines), with no connection to AI.
